title: The row's state label is its smallest, dimmest text (11 px grey), while the session name repeats in bold ('ember' / 'ember · done …')
repro: Open Home with an untitled session (ember) listed.
expected: The state and wait read first, at a glance. The name is not duplicated.

why: With Home open, the jump-failure bubble 'atlas: couldn't find its terminal — resume command copied' (02:57:31Z) sat under the panel: elementFromPoint at its centre = #chatInput; #bubble z-index 2 vs #chat z-index 3, and #chat's -46px bottom margin overlaps the bubble slot. Shot 07 shows the text ghosted behind the composer. (The 02:56:47Z nag bubble also fired while Home was open, under the same z-order; it was not captured separately.)
cause: renderer/style.css:26 (#bubble z-index 2) vs renderer/style.css:78 (#chat z-index 3, margin-bottom -46px)

why: delta's row (snapshot fanout total 3, done 3, open 0) showed only title, 'delta · done 3m ago' and its goal: no gauge or subagent count (shots 09, 10). renderHome never reads a.fanout, and the app's own gauge helpers foPips()/foTitle() have no call sites. Scope: the running fan-out was not re-run (a delta fan-out costs ~$0.10; fleet estimate $3.30 vs stop $3.32), but renderHome has no fan-out branch, so a running fan-out renders the same way.
cause: renderer/app.js:901 (Home rows ignore a.fanout); renderer/app.js:605 (foPips gauge never called)

why: An untitled session repeats its name: 'ember' (bold 13 px) over 'ember · 9s' (shot 10). The state and age are the row's smallest text: .nm small is 11 px rgb(100,108,122) on the light panel (about 5.1:1, legible) under a 13 px weight-650 title. The duplication is a template oversight; the hierarchy is polish.

title: T2: command results go to the speech bubble, which the open panel covers — a failed `/jump` and a finished `/stop` show nothing in the panel
repro: Home open; type `/jump ember` ⏎
Screenshot at 0.4 s and 2 s; read #bubble in the DOM
Start a fixture server in a fleet repo; type `/stop <its port>` ⏎
expected: Every command reports its outcome next to the bar within 1 s (note or inline status), success or failure.
actual: The failure line "ember: couldn't find its terminal — resume command copied" starts typing in the bubble at 145 ms and is complete at 2 s, but the bubble (z-index 2) sits under the panel (z-index 3) — the panel covers its centre and nothing is visible. No note is added. `/stop` adds no note either; "stopped pid 81736" goes to the bubble and, when the bubble is busy, queues behind "node (vibepet) on :… is up". Shots 06 and 27 show bubble text faintly behind the panel.
evidence: /Users/christopherharris/projects/vibepet/docs/ultra/round-1/packs/S3/timings.json: "/jump <visible session>: Enter → failure line starts typing in the speech bubble" (145.1 ms, n=6)
truth: ember idle (loop) 163 s; kestrel idle 132 s (question at end of turn); fixture servers :58570/:58637/:58654 alive before, gone 44–47 ms after Enter

why: After `/jump vibepet` failed, the bubble typed "vibepet: couldn't find its terminal — resume command copied" (z-index 2). elementFromPoint at its centre hit the Home panel (z-index 3). The panel got 0 new notes at 0.4 s and at 2 s, and the 2 s screenshot shows neither bubble nor note. `/stop <port>` x6: the server died 7-19 ms after Enter, and "stopped pid N" went only to the covered bubble (once queued behind "… went down"). The panel got 0 notes at 1 s and at chip removal. A cancelled stop gave no feedback at all. jumpTo stores a note with notes.set(), but noteFor() has no caller, so the promised "note in the row" never renders.
cause: renderer/app.js:745-752 (jumpTo reports only via say(); noteFor at app.js:615 is never called); main.js:432 + renderer/app.js:520 (/stop result -> bubble only); renderer/style.css:78 (#chat z-index 3) over renderer/style.css:26 (#bubble z-index 2)

truth: each jump returned {ok:false}; goal_done ledger entries written

title: The ask line — the exact question/command you act on — is nearly invisible: pale yellow on cream, 1.23:1 contrast
repro: A session ends its turn with a question (needs row)
Read the row's ask line
expected: The exact ask is legible at a glance (≥4.5:1, like the title's 15.1:1).
actual: 'Should the deploy script have unit tests?' rendered in pale yellow monospace on the cream needs-row background: strongest text pixel (249,219,149) on (246,245,239) = 1.23:1, measured on the screenshot.
truth: kestrel's last turn: 'Should the deploy script have unit tests?'

why: Jump-failure bubble 6/6 and 'goal hit … +15xp' bubble 4/4: the bubble (rect 252,601 156×25) lies under the open panel, and the element on top at its centre was #chatInput (inside #chat) every time. Nothing in #now or #msgs said 'couldn't'. Shot A04 shows the bubble only as ghost text behind the chat input. The per-row note jumpTo() stores is never drawn: noteFor() has no callers, and jumpTo re-renders only the hover roster, which is hidden while Home is open. Level-up not re-observed (xp stopped at 135 < 160), but it uses the same element and CSS.

Measured on my shot B01: the ask 'Should dry-run output be stored in logs for audit purposes?' has strongest text pixel (249,219,149) on (246,245,239), 1.23:1; the title is 15.10:1 and the label 4.82:1. The stuck row's 'Bash: ./deploy.sh --dry-run' uses the same colour (C03). .na is #ffd98a and the light-theme block never overrides it. This instance rendered its light theme (renderer prefers-color-scheme: light).

Press the jump key; screenshot 1.5 s later

title: A failed jump marks every done session seen, so they leave the jump queue unvisited
repro: With a fresh done session in the queue (vibepet, unseen), press the jump key (tmux: jump fails)
Read pending() right after; press again after >4 s
expected: Only a successful jump (or the user actually looking at that row) marks that one session seen; a failed jump leaves the queue as it was.
actual: Queue [vibepet(ready)] → press at 02:30:29 → jump {ok:false} → queue [] (jumpTo() calls markSeen() first, which marks ALL ready rows). The next press after the 4 s window has nothing to walk, though the user reached no terminal.
truth: done (end_turn 02:30:04.49), alive at its prompt in tmux

title: Jump key gives no feedback when its queue is empty

expected: A short acknowledgment (e.g. 'nobody's waiting on you') so a press is distinguishable from a dead key.
actual: 3 presses at 02:24: no bubble, no sound, no light change (shot 02) while kestrel was blocked 20.5 min and beacon 10.6 min.

title: Jump failure bubble names the session by folder ('kestrel') while the pill and rows lead with its title ('Deploy.sh dry run')
repro: Press the jump key on a queued session whose title differs from its folder
expected: One consistent label (title + folder) across the bubble, pill and Home row.
actual: Bubble 'kestrel: couldn't find its terminal…' vs pill/row 'Deploy.sh dry run'.

why: Pill open (pointer resting on Net, kestrel queued): failed jump at 03:08:38Z; bubble computed display:none in all 12 samples over 3.3 s, roster text never contained the note although notes held it; screenshots before and 1.5 s after are byte-identical (A03 = A04). Home open: failed jump at 03:09:00Z; bubble display:block but the element at its centre is #chatInput inside #chat, nothing visible (A06). Hidden Net + key: Net shown at once, pill opened, bubble hidden until +1563 ms of its ~5 s life (A07/A08).
cause: renderer/style.css:239 (#roster:not(.hidden) ~ #bubble {display:none}); renderer/app.js:615 (noteFor() has no caller; renderRoster app.js:571-585 renders no note); renderer/style.css:26 vs style.css:78 (#bubble z-index 2 under #chat z-index 3)

why: Queue [vibepet(ready, since 03:13:08.385Z)] -> press at 03:13:16.76Z -> ipc:jump {ok:false} -> queue [] while the snapshot still listed vibepet:ready; a second press 5.8 s later (outside the 4 s walk) made no jump call. The user reached no terminal, yet the done session left the key's walk. markSeen() also marks done rows that were not the jump target.
cause: renderer/app.js:746 (jumpTo calls markSeen() before and regardless of the jump result); renderer/app.js:104 (markSeen marks every ready row); renderer/app.js:123-125 (pending drops seen ready rows)

why: With pending() empty (after Esc on kestrel; beacon blocked on AskUserQuestion 58 min but invisible), 3 presses at 03:11:53–03:12:05Z: 'hotkey' reached the renderer each time, no jump call, bubble stayed hidden, no pill, no light change (A09). Silence is the coded intent ('nothing waiting = nothing happens'), but with key clashes undetected (07) and blocked sessions invisible (01) a press can't be told from a dead key. Polish.
cause: renderer/app.js:445-453 (empty queue -> handler returns with no feedback)

why: Failed-jump bubble read 'kestrel: couldn't find its terminal — resume command copied' (A02) while the roster pill and the Home row lead with the title 'Deploy.sh dry run' (A05). The app's own nag bubble uses the title ('Deploy.sh dry run has been blocked on approval 3m'), so bubbles disagree with each other too. Polish.
cause: renderer/app.js:751 (say uses a.name) vs renderer/app.js:580 and app.js:911 (title || name), main.js:238 (nag uses title || name)
